title: Stability & OOT Trend Watch
short: Watches stability and QC results to flag out-of-trend values before they become out-of-specification.
symptom: Out-of-spec results are found too late
ingredient: An early-warning layer for QC data
directions: Connect stability and release results. Get out-of-trend flags and projected shelf-life curves for the analyst to review.
problem: Stability and QC results are often reviewed point by point, so slow drifts are noticed only when a result fails specification.
why: A late out-of-specification result can mean recalls, shortened shelf life and costly investigations.
solution: Fits trend models to each product, test and storage condition, flags out-of-trend points early, and projects when a parameter may cross its limit.
limitations: Needs enough time points per batch
Supports, never replaces, the official OOS procedure
data: Stability results per batch, test, time point and storage condition
review: A QC analyst reviews every flag; OOS results follow the official investigation procedure.
